name: Margin Call Result 2 Choice
definition: Choice to provide the summation of the call amounts for the variation margin and the segregated independent amount, or the segregated independent amount only.

MarginCallResultDetails.name: Margin Call Result Details
MarginCallResultDetails.definition: Provides the summation of the call amounts for the variation margin and optionaly the segregated independent amount.

MarginCallAmount.name: Margin Call Amount
MarginCallAmount.definition: Provides the summation of the call amounts.

SegregatedIndependentAmount.name: Segregated Independent Amount
SegregatedIndependentAmount.definition: Provides the summation of the call amounts for the segregated independent amount only.
